_comment: Quarter of a 2x2 one-way mini roundabout, state 0 (frame of T 39: arms x-, z-, z+; +x closed; the block centre is the corner (x 0, z 255)). ENGLISH (right-hand traffic) runs the ring counter-clockwise seen from above: ring = x- (0,80) -> z+ (175,255), the outer lane of a curve round the block centre, radius 175 (same circle in every quarter). Entry from the arm: z- (175,0) -> z+ (175,255), straight, tangent to the ring where it joins it. Exit to the arm: x- (0,80) -> z- (80,0), a right turn of radius 80. No lane comes closer than 175 to the block centre; the art's island (netpaint paint.json) has radius 130 including its edge line. English-UK: lanekit mirror_uk reverses every lane (clockwise ring, left-hand traffic). Pinwheel (agreed with artkit and multitile): (x,z) state 3, (x+1,z) state 0, (x,z+1) state 2, (x+1,z+1) state 1; exits W, N, E, S. Pedestrians: the block's outer sidewalks only (round 1 used the T's graph, whose walks along the two internal sides crossed the ring and the island): crosswalk over the arm (15,15) -> (240,15), sidewalk along the closed side (240,15) -> (240,240); exits (15,15) to x- and z-, (240,15) to z-, (240,240) to z+. On the shared edges the neighbour quarter's (240,240) and (15,15) sit at the same points, so the walk goes round the outside of the block.
